Product Description:
We’re excited to introduce the VAPEHUB ULTRA 20,000 Puff Disposable Vape! With a strong 850mAh battery, it lasts for 20,000 puffs, so you can enjoy your flavours all day. The side screen shows real-time info on e-liquid and battery levels. You can adjust airflow and power with a button to suit your style. The Triple Mesh Coil gives great flavour with less waste. It’s comfy to hold, portable, and has safety features like temperature control to stop overheating.

Product Features:
– Puffs: Up to 20,000 puffs
– E-Liquid Capacity: 18ml
– Flavour Options: 15
– Battery Capacity: 850mAh (rechargeable)
– Resistance: Triple mesh coil 0.5Ω
– Size: 53 x 28.8 x 97.9 mm
